--- Segment 1 (from Episode 27, 28s) ---
[00:00.30-00:01.70] LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror): "You hear that?!"
[00:02.00-00:05.60] LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing): "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
[00:05.90-00:08.00] JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged): "That is not what I said!"
[00:08.40-00:09.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy): "Enough."
[00:12.00-00:15.70] ACTION: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
[00:13.40-00:16.50] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating): "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
[00:16.80-00:21.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive): "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
[00:21.20-00:22.10] BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern): "Take her."
[00:22.20-00:25.20] ACTION: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 4, 41s) ---
[00:00.00-00:03.00] THE PRIEST (Ceremonial): "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."
[00:03.00-00:04.80] THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming): "...husband and wife!"
[00:04.00-00:05.20] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[00:05.00-00:06.80] GERALD (Furious, Shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[00:07.00-00:09.00] GERALD (Livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[00:10.50-00:12.80] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[00:13.00-00:15.50] JULIANA (Firm, Final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[00:16.00-00:17.40] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[00:17.50-00:21.50] LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[00:22.00-00:24.50] LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous): "You are disowned!"
[00:29.50-00:30.80] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective): "Come, Lady Juliana."
[00:35.00-00:36.50] ACTION: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
[00:37.00-00:39.00] SFX: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
[00:37.50-00:41.40] ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 43, 22s) ---
[00:00.20-00:03.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Desperate): "I was told he was dead!"
[00:03.60-00:06.60] ALEXANDER (Cold, Penetrating): "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."
[00:06.80-00:09.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Betraying): "Sterling handled the report!"
[00:11.60-00:13.00] CATHERINE (Shocked, Murmuring): "My Lord?"
[00:13.80-00:15.80] SFX: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
[00:17.20-00:19.30] POLICE CONSTABLE (Firm, Sardonic): "Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 36, 41s) ---
[00:00.50-00:03.00] ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty): "...and killing my wife afterward."
[00:03.20-00:06.80] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified): "Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!"
[00:08.50-00:10.80] ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething): "They already took my name."
[00:11.60-00:13.60] ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction): "They stole my home!"
[00:14.20-00:16.80] ALEXANDER (Venomous): "And now they have taken Juliana!"
[00:17.00-00:19.50] ACTION: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
[00:17.50-00:19.20] SFX: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
[00:20.00-00:24.00] ACTION: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.
[00:22.00-00:23.50] ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling): "Two days."
[00:24.50-00:27.80] ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance): "Then they have two days to celebrate."
[00:29.50-00:32.20] ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise): "Because before that wedding begins..."
[00:33.00-00:36.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale): "...their dead Duke is coming home."
[00:37.00-00:40.75] ACTION: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
[00:37.00-00:40.75] SFX: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 42, 56s) ---
[00:00.10-00:03.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[00:04.10-00:05.50] ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant): "We will not."
[00:05.60-00:07.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[00:07.60-00:08.60] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged): "Why?!"
[00:08.80-00:10.90] ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[00:11.10-00:12.40] CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[00:12.60-00:15.90] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[00:16.10-00:21.90] ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[00:22.30-00:24.60] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears): "Alexander..."
[00:26.90-00:30.10] ACTION: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
[00:30.10-00:31.10] ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent): "Mother."
[00:31.10-00:36.10] ACTION: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
[00:31.30-00:35.90] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving): "Look at you... my beautiful boy."
[00:36.10-00:43.90] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud): "I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
[00:44.10-00:46.10] ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute): "I have come home, Mother."
[00:46.10-00:54.60] ACTION: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
[00:46.30-00:54.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative): "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 23, 50s) ---
[00:00.00-00:01.00] SFX: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.
[00:00.50-00:02.50] PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified): "Poison?"
[00:04.50-00:06.50] LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute): "Arsenic."
[00:06.50-00:09.00] SFX: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
[00:13.00-00:15.50] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging): "Can you save her?"
[00:16.00-00:18.50] LADY JULIANA (Focused, Resolute): "I can try."
[00:23.00-00:30.50] SFX: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.
[00:26.00-00:30.50] LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused): "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."
[00:30.70-00:32.50] SFX: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!
[00:37.30-00:42.50] PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper): "Juliana... someone is coming."
[00:47.70-00:49.70] SFX: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 7, 30s) ---
[00:00.00-00:01.70] GERALD (V.O.) (Snarl): "Where is that beggar husband?"
[00:00.50-00:06.00] ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
[00:06.70-00:08.00] SFX: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
[00:12.00-00:14.50] ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
[00:17.00-00:19.00] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed): "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
[00:19.10-00:20.50] GERALD (Trembling, Trying to Save Face): "What are you staring at?"
[00:20.50-00:22.00] ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
[00:20.60-00:21.90] GERALD (Nervous, Hurried): "We are leaving."
[00:22.50-00:24.30] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Outraged, Flustered): "Leaving? Gerald!"
[00:24.30-00:27.00] ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
[00:25.50-00:26.50] SFX: Carriage door slamming shut.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 26, 39s) ---
[00:00.20-00:06.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Heartbroken): "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
[00:06.80-00:10.90] JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast): "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
[00:18.00-00:23.60] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching): "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
[00:24.20-00:30.00] JULIANA (Painful, Proud): "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
[00:31.20-00:34.70] ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[00:34.40-00:36.20] SFX: A sharp, stunned gasp.
[00:35.00-00:39.20] ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 35, 36s) ---
[00:00.00-00:01.70] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked): "A traitor?"
[00:02.20-00:03.40] ALEXANDER (Cold, Firm): "Yes."
[00:04.70-00:07.20] ALEXANDER (Grave): "We were close to finding him."
[00:08.70-00:11.20] ALEXANDER (Hardened): "Then came the ambush."
[00:11.70-00:14.40] ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful): "My men were slaughtered."
[00:14.70-00:16.20] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious): "And you?"
[00:17.20-00:20.20] ALEXANDER (Hollow): "I was shot. Left for dead."
[00:21.20-00:23.20] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished): "How did you escape?"
[00:24.20-00:28.20] ALEXANDER (Somber, Low): "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
[00:28.40-00:32.20] ALEXANDER (Continuing): "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
[00:32.20-00:35.70] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned): "Then why did they never tell us?"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 12, 45s) ---
[00:00.40-00:01.70] JULIANA (Guarded, Cold): "What do you want?"
[00:02.20-00:04.60] CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring): "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[00:04.90-00:10.50] CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive): "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[00:10.60-00:14.90] CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic): "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[00:15.00-00:16.20] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[00:15.50-00:18.80] CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[00:19.00-00:21.30] GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive): "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[00:21.50-00:23.30] CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional): "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[00:23.60-00:27.40] CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing): "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
[00:27.80-00:29.40] ACTION: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
[00:28.00-00:32.00] ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent): "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
[00:32.40-00:34.20] ACTION: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
[00:33.50-00:36.40] JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial): "I am not letting them take you."
[00:39.70-00:41.20] ACTION: Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
[00:41.00-00:42.90] JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Tell me where the garden is."
[00:42.90-00:45.41] ACTION: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 29, 34s) ---
[00:00.10-00:01.80] JULIANA (Furious, Shouted): "You know that is a lie!"
[00:02.00-00:04.20] CATHERINE (Calm, Sinister): "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
[00:04.40-00:06.50] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "You cannot just destroy it!"
[00:07.30-00:09.10] CATHERINE (Whispered, Malicious): "I can burn it."
[00:10.10-00:13.60] CATHERINE (O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless): "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
[00:13.80-00:16.50] CATHERINE (Cruel, Resolute): "...no one will remember what was written inside."
[00:16.70-00:19.00] JULIANA (Enraged, Defiant): "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
[00:19.30-00:23.40] CATHERINE (Scornful, Arrogant): "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."
[00:24.50-00:26.50] CATHERINE (Cold, Venomous): "You were cast out once."
[00:27.20-00:29.10] CATHERINE (Menacing): "You should have stayed forgotten."
[00:29.80-00:31.40] JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "My husband will find me."
[00:32.10-00:34.30] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Amused): "Your scarred soldier?"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 45, 49s) ---
[00:00.10-00:02.40] ACTION: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
[00:01.10-00:02.60] JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering): "You're the Duke?"
[00:02.80-00:05.60] ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant): "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
[00:05.80-00:07.80] JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved): "All this time?"
[00:08.40-00:11.20] ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep): "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
[00:11.40-00:13.10] JULIANA (Sincere, Loving): "I chose you because you were kind."
[00:13.30-00:15.00] ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate): "You chose me when I had nothing."
[00:15.20-00:16.90] JULIANA (Resolute, Warm): "I chose you because you had honor."
[00:17.00-00:20.00] ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted): "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
[00:20.40-00:26.70] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
[00:22.00-00:24.20] JULIANA (Soft, Heartfelt): "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
[00:24.30-00:27.00] ALEXANDER (Soft, Vowing): "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
[00:27.20-00:29.70] ACTION: Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.
[00:28.00-00:29.70] CATHERINE (Pleading, Desperate): "Alexander..."
[00:32.20-00:36.20] ALEXANDER (Furious, Cold): "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
[00:36.40-00:38.00] CATHERINE (Gasping, Lying): "I didn't know!"
[00:38.20-00:40.60] ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Biting): "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
[00:40.80-00:45.00] ALEXANDER (Booming, Condemning): "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
[00:47.00-00:48.70] CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned): "Wife?!"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 32, 32s) ---
[00:00.00-00:01.20] CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking): "A disgraced woman?"
[00:01.40-00:04.60] JULIANA (Unwavering): "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
[00:05.00-00:06.40] CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged): "You are lying!"
[00:06.80-00:10.20] JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic): "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
[00:10.40-00:13.20] JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing): "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
[00:13.30-00:19.00] JULIANA (Passionate, Clear): "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
[00:19.40-00:21.10] JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious): "Let him have Clarissa."
[00:21.80-00:23.40] JULIANA (Proud): "He lost me."
[00:23.50-00:25.40] CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious): "You were rejected!"
[00:25.60-00:29.80] JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful): "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
[00:30.00-00:31.60] CATHERINE (Disdainful): "Your soldier?"

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 38, 42s) ---
[00:00.00-00:02.00] JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading): "What if I die here?"
[00:02.30-00:05.00] JULIANA (Heartbroken): "What if I never see you again?"
[00:03.00-00:05.50] ACTION: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
[00:06.00-00:08.00] JULIANA (Fervent Prayer): "Keep him safe."
[00:08.30-00:09.80] JULIANA (Resigned): "Wherever he is."
[00:10.00-00:11.50] JULIANA (Determined): "Let him live."
[00:12.00-00:15.00] JULIANA (Steely): "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
[00:15.30-00:17.00] JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable): "I will not give them my husband."
[00:17.30-00:18.70] JULIANA (Resolute): "I will not betray him."
[00:19.00-00:21.00] ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
[00:19.30-00:41.50] SFX: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
[00:23.50-00:24.80] JULIANA (Startled Whisper): "Bells."
[00:25.50-00:28.00] ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
[00:27.30-00:28.70] JULIANA (Realizing): "The wedding."
[00:29.00-00:30.30] JULIANA (Grim): "It's beginning."
[00:30.50-00:33.00] JULIANA (Somber, Steely): "Then I suppose I'm next."
[00:35.50-00:38.50] ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
[00:37.00-00:38.50] JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender): "Alexander..."
[00:39.00-00:42.41] SFX: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 24, 58s) ---
[00:00.00-00:00.70] ACTION: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
[00:00.00-00:02.70] ACTION: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
[00:01.20-00:03.00] NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening): "You are a maid."
[00:03.20-00:05.00] NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing): "Not a physician. Not a lady."
[00:05.20-00:09.00] NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final): "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."
[00:09.40-00:11.00] LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled): "Yes, my lady."
[00:11.70-00:14.20] NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending): "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."
[00:14.70-00:17.70] ACTION: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
[00:17.70-00:19.70] ACTION: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
[00:19.80-00:21.40] NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive): "Clean it."
[00:22.40-00:23.80] LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning): "All of it, my lady?"
[00:24.00-00:29.70] NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous): "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."
[00:30.00-00:32.20] ACTION: Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
[00:32.20-00:33.70] ACTION: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
[00:32.40-00:33.70] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading): "My lady—"
[00:33.70-00:35.70] ACTION: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
[00:34.20-00:36.70] NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening): "Do you want the same punishment?"
[00:36.80-00:38.60] PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring): "No, my lady."
[00:38.70-00:40.70] ACTION: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
[00:39.20-00:47.20] SFX: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
[00:41.20-00:44.20] NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful): "That is where clever little servants belong."
[00:44.80-00:47.20] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute): "Let her think I am only a maid."
[00:47.40-00:51.20] ACTION: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
[00:47.70-00:51.00] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant): "Let her believe I am ignorant."
[00:51.40-00:57.70] ACTION: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
[00:51.80-00:56.00] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable): "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 50, 26s) ---
[00:00.30-00:02.00] CATHERINE (Murmuring): "In another room no one uses?"
[00:02.30-00:04.70] FATHER THOMAS (Whispering): "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
[00:05.80-00:10.30] CATHERINE (Low, Carnal): "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
[00:11.30-00:16.00] ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
[00:16.30-00:19.00] ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
[00:19.50-00:22.00] ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
[00:22.30-00:24.00] ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
[00:22.70-00:24.10] SFX: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

--- Segment 1 (from Episode 1, 47s) ---
[00:00.70-00:01.90] LADY JULIANA (Trembling): "How long?"
[00:02.60-00:06.10] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Cruel, Poised): "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
[00:06.60-00:08.60] ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
